name: Personality
summary: Gives Alexia a voice of your choosing. It changes how answers are phrased and never what they say.

settings.label: Voice
settings.hint: Default is Alexia's own voice and costs nothing — no extra model call happens at all. Anything else adds one short call per answer.

settings.label: Your own description
settings.placeholder: Blunt, no filler, dry humour when it fits
settings.hint: Used only when Voice is set to custom. Describe how to speak, not what to say.
